original_requirement: Register exactly two real-Canary approval profiles and make PA-STRICT-TOOL-OBS-1 Candidate, Patch and Signed Approval deterministic, profile-aware, single-use and fail-closed without executing a provider call.
operational_definition: C0B and PA are the only registered profiles; Candidate and Patch are non-executable at launcher and ledger boundaries; a Signed Approval must bind exact profile, plan, launcher, workload, build, runtime, target, schema, budget, window and source artifacts.
forbidden_narrowing: A Candidate or Patch cannot be described as executable authorization.
A successful validate-only closure cannot be described as a provider observation.
A target observation outcome cannot be described as workflow completion.
Legacy C0B compatibility cannot weaken the registered Signed Approval path.
No generated PA document can be described as final user authorization.
closed_world_justification: The registry is immutable and contains exactly two profiles; only Canary control-plane, tests and reports changed.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Candidate, Patch and Signed Approval remain distinct and deterministic.
constraint_traceability.implementation: Profile-specific validators and materializers are reached through a finite generic dispatcher.
constraint_traceability.evidence: 32 PA-AUTH contract cases cover exact binding, tamper, expiry, cross-profile rejection and single-use consumption.

constraint_traceability.implementation: Legacy C0B read-only validation remains explicit while registered Signed Approval uses the profile dispatcher.

constraint_traceability.requirement: No Provider, credential, network or model action occurs.
constraint_traceability.implementation: Materialization uses the existing fail-closed network sentinel and emits only disabled Candidate and Patch Template artifacts.
constraint_traceability.evidence: All five external counters are zero and execution_performed is false.

projected_failure_mechanisms: candidate or patch supplied to real-run
model_output_not_applicable_evidence: src/novel_flywheel and baml_src have zero changed files; Prompt, provider route, retry/fallback, parser, adapter and Runtime behavior are unchanged.
why_previous_tests_missed: The earlier PA package stopped at an inert Candidate and did not have a registered PA Signed Approval contract or generic profile-aware launcher/ledger dispatch.

sibling_boundaries.evidence: Full Canary suite passed, including C0B signed approval and closure suites.
No production source changed; before/after live parity is exact.
Candidate/Patch are rejected and no Signed Approval exists; zero external counters prove no execution occurred.

remaining_risks: No real-provider observation exists until a new final user authorization materializes a Signed Approval.
The one future run may not reach the exact target boundary.
Provider capability may terminate the workflow after or before the observation goal.
